section_header: EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEMS — Dash Pot (DP) System
title: DASH POT (DP) SYSTEM

content.description: Overview diagram showing the Dash Pot system installation with VTV (Vacuum Transmitting Valve), Air Filter, and Dash Pot components mounted on the throttle body
Two side-by-side schematic diagrams showing DP Diaphragm operation during Normal Driving and Deceleration conditions, with VTV valve positions illustrated

content.text: To reduce HC and CO emissions, when decelerating the dash pot opens the throttle valve slightly more than at idle. This causes the air-fuel mixture to burn completely.
